chunks: Al-Husayn ibn Muhammad from Mu'alla ibn Muhammad, and Muhammad ibn Yahya from Ahmad ibn Muhammad, all together from Al-Hasan ibn Ali al-Washsha, from Ahmad ibn A'idh, from Abu Khadija, from Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him) who said:

Give the Zakat to those of the Banu Hashim who desire it, for it is permissible for them, and it is prohibited only upon the Prophet (peace be upon him and his family), and the Imam who comes after him, and the Imams, may the prayers of Allah be upon them all.
ai.seo_question: Can members of the Banu Hashim receive Zakat?
ai.summary: This hadith from al-Kafi clarifies the distinction between the general prohibition of Zakat for the Prophet and the specific Imams, allowing other Banu Hashim members to receive it. It reflects the Shia scholarly view that the Imam's status as a recipient of divine provision (ghina) exempts him, while other Hashimites remain eligible. This ruling underscores the unique spiritual and legal standing of the Ahl al-Bayt in matters of charity distribution.
